description: This file defines the CompoundTypeAliasTree class, which implements a prefix tree (trie) for representing compound type aliases, primarily for serialization purposes within the Orleans framework.

classes.name: CompoundTypeAliasTree
classes.description: Represents a prefix tree structure for managing compound type aliases, supporting addition and retrieval of child nodes with associated types.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Creates a new instance of the tree with an empty root node.

methods.name: GetChildOrDefault
methods.description: Retrieves a child node by key, or null if not present.

methods.name: TryGetChild
methods.description: Attempts to find a child node with the specified key, returning true if found.

methods.name: Add
methods.description: Adds a node with a key of type Type or string, returning the new or existing node.

methods.name: AddInternal
methods.description: Internal method that performs the actual addition of nodes with specified key and optional value.
